en: The image shows an old, sepia-toned photograph of an archaeological site with stone ruins. Two people are sitting among the ruins, and there is a solitary tree and a small structure in the background. The text at the top, in Spanish, reads 'SAN MARTÍN DE AMPURIAS. Vista parcial en el interior de la ciudad Griega,' which translates to 'SAN MARTÍN DE AMPURIAS. Partial view inside the Greek city.'
